text:
The user wants me to add a comparison drawer for spec-default versus spec-off measurements. This is a drawer/side panel that allows comparing measurements when speculative decoding is enabled (spec-default) versus disabled (spec-off).

I need to:
1. Keep all existing functionality (dashboard with 600 requests, sticky inspector, cache-tier legend, admission-pressure strip, incident timeline, keyboard navigation, etc.)
2. Add a comparison drawer that shows spec-default vs spec-off measurements
3. Make it a drawer (likely slides in from the side or bottom)
4. Include relevant metrics like TTFT, decode time, throughput, etc.
5. Return a complete, self-contained HTML document

Let me think about the design:
- A drawer that can be toggled open/closed
- Shows two columns or sections: Spec-Default and Spec-Off
- Compares key metrics: average TTFT, average decode time, throughput, cache hit rate, etc.
- Could be triggered by a button in the header or toolbar
- Should be accessible (keyboard dismissible, focus management)

I'll add a button in the header to toggle the drawer, and the drawer will slide in from the right side. It will show aggregated statistics comparing the two modes.
